source_sql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema,c.relname AS table,c.reltuples::bigint AS estimated_rows FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON c.relnamespace=n.oid WHERE n.nspname ~ '^taqm_20(19|20|21|22|23|24|25)$' AND c.relname ~ '^ctm_[0-9]{8}$' AND substring(c.relname from 5)>= '20190101' AND substring(c.relname from 5)<='20250801' ORDER BY 2
